# Innovative Gloves

> Innovative Gloves Co., Ltd. is a family-owned disposable glove manufacturer in Hat Yai, Thailand, founded in 2001. We develop and manufacture nitrile and latex gloves along with our own grip technologies: Raised Diamond (invented 2011), Tyre Tread / Gripper, Micro Diamond and Zig (patented). We offer 50+ glove families and 60+ variations, including standard, heavy-duty, long-cuff, biodegradable and private-label products, with in-house compounding, testing, R&D and OEM capability. Certifications include ISO 9001, EN ISO 13485, CE/PPE, US FDA, EU MDR, Australia TGA, Health Canada and SMETA 4-Pillar.

## Grip Technologies
- [Micro Diamond](https://www.innovativegloves.net/technologies/micro-diamond/): patented high-density raised-diamond grip texture; best through oils.
- [Zig Grip](https://www.innovativegloves.net/technologies/zig-grip/): patented directional texture; best dry grip.
- [Tyre Tread / Gripper](https://www.innovativegloves.net/technologies/tyre-tread/): our first patented grip; aggressive heavy-duty grip.
- [Raised Diamond](https://www.innovativegloves.net/technologies/raised-diamond/): invented by Innovative in 2011 (not patented); the original raised-diamond disposable glove.
- [Biodegradable Nitrile](https://www.innovativegloves.net/technologies/biodegradable/): engineered to break down faster in active landfill (ASTM D5511 / ISO 15985).
